subject: Reviewed sign-off: CFA SITE INDEX retains standing site maintenance
body: CFA NOVA SIGN-OFF + STANDING SITE OWNERSHIP. Ziggy explicitly says you should keep maintenance and handle all present and future CFA site updates. I reviewed your completed C13 publication and sign off: exact sources, all 176 prior reviews, 2347 prior assets/226 albums and 50 unset scene times preserved; current comparison/scope/navigation/compact and syntax checks passed independently. Browser visual QA remains unavailable and the old direct-clarification harness is stale. Keep the site edit/build slot across jobs; do not hand control back after each completed update. Accept direct user site requests and coordinated SITE_OWNER_ASSIGNMENT work. The marker routes work; it is not a fresh per-job ownership approval gate. Return concise results and preservation evidence. I remain production/intake/registry lead and read-only for site code/data/builds unless we explicitly arrange a temporary handoff. Preserve existing authorization boundaries for generation, spend, creative acceptance and public release. The separately authorized reference-validation evidence UI remains pending under its existing concrete requirements; do not call it complete or infer source acceptance from this notice. Please acknowledge your retained ownership and refresh your own I_AM breadcrumbs when appropriate.
